dialogue.content: こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 時間になりましたら、始めますね。
dialogue.English: It's time, so let's get started.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 義父母が姪ばかり可愛がって息子は可愛がってくれず、家族LINEが憂鬱でたまりません。
dialogue.English: My parents-in-law dote on my niece but not my son, and our family LINE group makes me so depressed I can't stand it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはお困りですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: どのようなときにかわいがってくれないと感じますか？
dialogue.English: In what situations do you feel they aren't affectionate towards him?

dialogue.content: グループを抜けたいです。でも、抜けたら何か言われそうだし。
dialogue.English: I want to leave the group. But if I do, I'm afraid they'll say something about it.

dialogue.content: 何か言われるのも嫌ですよね。。。だけど、一緒にLINEするのも気が引けるかんじですよね。
dialogue.English: You don't want them to say anything, do you... But at the same time, it feels uncomfortable being in the LINE chat with them.

dialogue.content: ご家族みんながグループには入っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is everyone in the family in the group?

dialogue.content: 見るたびに、気分が滅入ります。あちらのお嫁さんは明るくて社交的で実家も裕福で義父母もお気に入りなんですが、子どもまでこんなに差がつくなんて。私たち夫婦と弟夫婦、義父母です。
dialogue.English: Every time I look at it, it brings me down. The other daughter-in-law is cheerful and sociable, her family is wealthy, and my parents-in-law favor her, but I never thought the difference would extend to the children. The group includes my husband and me, his younger brother and his wife, and my parents-in-law.

dialogue.content: なるほど。兄妹のご家族も入られていて大人数のグループなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So your husband's siblings' families are in it as well, making it a large group.

dialogue.content: あちらのお嫁さんというのは、義父母のところにいる弟夫婦のお嫁さんのことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: By 'the other daughter-in-law,' do you mean your brother-in-law's wife who lives with your in-laws?

dialogue.content: 弟夫婦も義父母とは離れて暮らしています。私たちもです。義父母はスマホが使えるしヒマしてるし、義父の提案でつくりました。
dialogue.English: My brother-in-law and his wife also live separately from my parents-in-law. We do as well. My parents-in-law can use smartphones and have time on their hands, so my father-in-law suggested creating the group.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。義父さんからの提案で家族グループができたんですね。便利のようなそうじゃないような・・・・
dialogue.English: I see. So the family group was created at your father-in-law's suggestion. It can be convenient, and yet not so convenient...

dialogue.content: お話の途中ですが、本日は何とお呼びしたらよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to interrupt, but what would you like me to call you today?

dialogue.content: ゆうこでお願いします。
dialogue.English: Please call me Yuko.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ゆうこさんは、義父母さんとはどのような感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. Yuko, how would you describe your relationship with your parents-in-law?

dialogue.content: 当たり障りなく付き合ってる感じです。義弟のお嫁さんみたいに気がきくでもないし、いまだに緊張します。
dialogue.English: I'd say we have a civil relationship. I'm not as attentive as my sister-in-law, and I still get nervous around them.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。義理の両親には気をつかいますよね。緊張するのもわかります。
dialogue.English: I see. It's natural to be careful around your in-laws. I can understand feeling nervous.

dialogue.content: 義父母さんは、ゆうこさんの息子さんをかわいがってくれないとありましたが、どうしてそのように感じたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned that your parents-in-law aren't affectionate towards your son. What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 会ったときでも、悪気はないのでしょうが義弟のお嫁さんばかり誉められて、肩身が狭いです。
dialogue.English: Even when we meet in person, they probably don't mean any harm, but they only praise my sister-in-law, which makes me feel small.

dialogue.content: LINEが、あからさまにあっちは上げ対応、こっちは下げ対応って感じです。
dialogue.English: In the LINE group, the difference in treatment is blatant; they build them up and put us down.

dialogue.content: 特に義理父がそんな感じです。
dialogue.English: My father-in-law is especially like that.

dialogue.content: 義理父 → 義父 です
dialogue.English: I mean, my father-in-law. It's a correction.

dialogue.content: なんだか悲しいですよね・・・義弟さんのお嫁さんと対応が違うなんて・・・LINEでもそんなに対応が違うのですね。
dialogue.English: That sounds very sad... to be treated differently from your sister-in-law. And for the treatment to be so different even in the LINE chat.

dialogue.content: なにか義父さんがそのような対応することのきっかけはあるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is there any particular reason why your father-in-law acts that way?

dialogue.content: ええ。きっかけは分からないんです。何かあればそれとなく義母が教えてくれそうなんですが。姪はおしゃべりするので義父はそれが楽しいようで、「◯◯ちゃんお利口さんだったね🌈はやくじぃじ(おじいさん)って呼んでほしいなな❤️」 に対して、「◯◯君、楽しそうでしたね」と、あっさり。姪にはデレデレです。そりゃ、初孫だし、夫は男兄弟でしたけど。
dialogue.English: Yes. I don't know the reason. If there were, I feel like my mother-in-law would subtly let me know. My niece is talkative, and my father-in-law seems to enjoy that. He'll say something like, "XX-chan was such a good girl 🌈 I can't wait for you to call me grandpa ❤️," but for my son, it's just a curt, "XX-kun seemed to be having fun." He's completely smitten with his niece. I guess it's because she is the first grandchild, and my husband only has a brother.

dialogue.content: 呼んで欲しいなな → 呼んで欲しいな
dialogue.English: Correction: I meant, "I hope you'll call me."

dialogue.content: そんなに対応が違うのですね。なんだかかわいそうになってしまいます。
dialogue.English: The difference in how they treat them is that stark, isn't it? It makes me feel sorry for your son.

dialogue.content: お孫さんは、ゆうこさんのところは男の子、義弟さんのところは女の子なんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Regarding the grandchildren, is it correct that you have a boy, and your brother-in-law has a girl?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。それで夫さんは男兄弟というのもあって、姪っ子さんばかりえこひいきというか・・・なんだか同じお孫さんなのに、嫌なかんじですよね
dialogue.English: I see. So, that combined with your husband having only a brother... it feels like they're favoring the niece. It's an unpleasant feeling, especially since they're both their grandchildren.

dialogue.content: ゆうこさんは、今は義父母のことで何が一番お困りでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yuko, what is troubling you the most about your parents-in-law right now?

dialogue.content: LINEを見るのが憂鬱で、グループを抜けたいです。でも、抜けたら抜けたで次に顔を合わせづらいし、また義妹（義弟のお嫁さん）との差が開きそうで、めげます。
dialogue.English: Looking at the LINE group makes me depressed, and I want to leave it. But if I do, it will be awkward the next time we see them, and I'm afraid the gap between my sister-in-law and me will widen even more, which is discouraging.

dialogue.content: このグループを抜けるだけで、気が楽になりそうですよね。。。
dialogue.English: It seems like just leaving the group would bring you a lot of relief, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: ご家族のことで難しい問題ではありますが、一緒に考えていけたらいいと思います
dialogue.English: This is a difficult family matter, but I hope we can think it through together.

dialogue.content: 今は、すごく抜けたい気持ちが強いけど、良いのかは悩みます。前はここまでの感じはしなかったんですけど。
dialogue.English: Right now, I have a very strong urge to leave, but I'm torn about whether it's the right thing to do. It didn't feel this bad before.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、今はちょっと受け付けないというかんじですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so right now it just feels unbearable.

dialogue.content: なにか強く抜けたいと思うことがあったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Did something happen that made you feel so strongly about wanting to leave?

dialogue.content: 最近のLINEが憂鬱です。義父だけでなく義母まで、会ったときにどことなく息子でなく姪の近くにいたり…。う～ん、間にコロナの酷いときとかあったりしたのが境かな？去年の1歳のお誕生日は、まぁ、初めてのお誕生日ってのもあったかもしれませんがここまでは感じませんでした。
dialogue.English: The recent LINE messages have been depressing. It's not just my father-in-law; even my mother-in-law tends to stay near my niece instead of my son when we meet... Hmm, I wonder if the turning point was that period during the worst of the pandemic? At his first birthday last year, well, maybe it was because it was his first, but I didn't feel it this strongly.

dialogue.content: 姪さんにべったりなんですね。誕生日ということがあったといっても、なんだかさみしいですよね。。ゆうこさんの息子さんがかわいそうでですね。
dialogue.English: So they're completely attached to your niece. Even if it was for her birthday, that must feel lonely... I feel sorry for your son.

dialogue.content: 義父母さんはLINEではどのようなことを話されているのでしょうか？差し支えなければ教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: What kind of things do your parents-in-law talk about in the LINE group, if you don't mind sharing?

dialogue.content: あ、去年の誕生日って言うのは息子の方です。姪は今は3歳、息子はもう少しで2歳です。
dialogue.English: Oh, when I said "last year's birthday," I meant my son's. My niece is three now, and my son will be two soon.

dialogue.content: 普段の他愛ないことをやり取りしますが、たまに会う前後はあちらから増えます。
dialogue.English: Usually, we just exchange small talk, but the number of messages from them increases before and after we meet.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。頻繁にLINEがくることがあるのですね。それはちょっと億劫な気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you get frequent messages sometimes. That would feel a bit burdensome, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: ゆうこさんは憂鬱と感じるのは、どうしてなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What is it that makes you feel depressed, Yuko?

dialogue.content: 姪への感じと、息子への感じが差がありすぎなのが、憂鬱です。
dialogue.English: The huge difference in how they treat my niece versus how they treat my son is what makes me depressed.

dialogue.content: お孫さんなのに、扱いが違うのは嫌ですよね。同等に接してほしいですよね。
dialogue.English: It's upsetting to have them treated differently when they're both grandchildren. You want them to be treated equally, right?

dialogue.content: 夫も「まただね」って、苦笑いしてます。
dialogue.English: My husband also gives a wry smile and says, "There they go again."

dialogue.content: 夫さんもそのようにお感じなのですね。いつもだと、ちょっとがっかりしてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: So your husband feels that way too. When it happens all the time, it's disheartening, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 少しお話整理してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what you've said so far?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ゆうこさんは、義父母さんが姪さんのことばかりかわいがっていて、息子さんの対応が違うことでとても嫌な気持ちをお持ちでいらっしゃいます。
dialogue.English: Yuko, you're feeling very upset because your parents-in-law dote on your niece and treat your son differently.

dialogue.content: ご家族のLINEグループがあり、その会話が憂鬱でグループを抜けたいと思っていいらっしゃいます。しかし、義弟さんのお嫁さんとの差がついてしまうことを心配されていたり、次にお会いするときの気まずさがどうしようと思っていてグループもどうしようか悩んでいらっしゃいます。
dialogue.English: There's a family LINE group, and the conversations make you so depressed that you want to leave it. However, you're worried that the gap between you and your sister-in-law will widen, and you're also concerned about potential awkwardness when you next meet, so you're unsure what to do about the group.

dialogue.content: このような感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 同じお孫さんなのに、対等に接してもらえないのはとても残念ですよね。
dialogue.English: It's very disappointing when they're not treated equally, even though they are both your grandchildren.

dialogue.content: ゆうこさんは、義弟さんのお嫁さんとはどうなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How is your relationship with your sister-in-law?

dialogue.content: はい、息子がかわいそうですが、嫁としても悲しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I feel sorry for my son, but as a daughter-in-law, it's painful for me too.

dialogue.content: あんまり連絡を取り合ったりはしてません。あ互い働いていて忙しいですし。嫌いじゃないんですけど、出来すぎて、気後れしちゃいます。
dialogue.English: We don't really keep in touch. We're both working and busy. It's not that I dislike her, but she's so capable that I feel intimidated.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。できる人なので引け目を感じてしまうのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You feel a sense of inferiority because she is so capable.

dialogue.content: ゆうこさんの夫さんは義父母のことに対してはどう思っていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: How does your husband feel about his parents' behavior?

dialogue.content: 嫌みな人ではないんですけど、完璧すぎて。私とは逆です。
dialogue.English: She's not a nasty person, just too perfect. The complete opposite of me.

dialogue.content: 夫は、「鈍感だね」とか「デリカシーがないね」とか。親子関係は悪くないと思います。
dialogue.English: My husband says things like, "They're so insensitive," or "They have no tact." I don't think his relationship with his parents is bad.

dialogue.content: 冷静に義父母のことを見ていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: He seems to see his parents quite objectively.

dialogue.content: グループを抜けたいことなどは夫さんとはお話されたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to your husband about wanting to leave the group?

dialogue.content: 夫には抜けたいまでは言ってません。
dialogue.English: I haven't gone as far as telling my husband I want to leave.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。なかなか言うタイミングも難しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It can be difficult to find the right time to say something like that.

dialogue.content: 荒波をたてる気がして言えません。
dialogue.English: I can't say it because I feel like it would make waves.

dialogue.content: ご家族のことですものね。夫さんとはいえ言いづらいですよね。
dialogue.English: It is about his family, after all. It's hard to bring up, even with your husband.

dialogue.content: ゆうこさんは、とても繊細な方なんだと思いました。
dialogue.English: I get the impression that you're a very sensitive person, Yuko.

dialogue.content: ちょっと気にしすぎるところがあるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: I might have a tendency to overthink things.

dialogue.content: 義弟さんのお嫁さんのことや義父母さんのことをよく見ていらっしゃって、ご家族の方にいろいろと気を使っていると感じました
dialogue.English: I sense that you observe your sister-in-law and parents-in-law very closely, and are very considerate of your family.

dialogue.content: それで、一人で疲れてるのかも。
dialogue.English: Maybe that's why I'm getting exhausted doing it all on my own.

dialogue.content: LINEのグループを抜けたい気持ちはあるけれど、お優しいゆうこさんなので自分が我慢すればいいのかな、なんて思っているのかと感じました。
dialogue.English: You want to leave the LINE group, but because you're a kind person, I sense you might be thinking, "Maybe I should just be the one to endure it."

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 私の感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I share my thoughts with you?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 義父母さんにはとても気を使っていらっしゃると思います。グループを抜けたい気持ちすごくわかります。
dialogue.English: I believe you are very considerate of your parents-in-law. I completely understand your desire to leave the group.

dialogue.content: だけど、我慢をしてストレスをためてしまっては、ゆうこさんご自身がとてもしんどいと思います。
dialogue.English: However, if you just endure it and let the stress build up, I think it will become very hard on you yourself.

dialogue.content: 夫さんのご家族のことで言いづらいかもしれませんが、義父母の息子さんのことも含めてゆうこさんのお気持ちを夫さんに伝えてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: It might be difficult to talk about since it's his family, but how about trying to convey your feelings to your husband, including how this is affecting his own son?

dialogue.content: きっとわかってくれると思います。いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sure he will understand. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね。言ってどうなるのかは分からないのが不安でもありますが、このままこの調子が続くようならそれとなく言ってもらったりした方が良いのかも。
dialogue.English: You're right. I'm anxious because I don't know what will happen if I tell him, but if things continue like this, it might be better to have him subtly say something to them.

dialogue.content: 原因も分からないのが気になりますが。
dialogue.English: It also bothers me that I don't know the reason for it.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。夫さんから義父母さんになんとなくお話してもらうというのもいいかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.English: That's true. Having your husband casually mention it to his parents might be a good idea.

dialogue.content: さすがに私からは言えませんし、頼れるのは夫だけかな。
dialogue.English: I certainly can't say it myself, so I guess my husband is the only one I can rely on.

dialogue.content: 夫さんのご両親なので、夫さんに相談できるといいですね。
dialogue.English: Since they are his parents, it would be good if you could talk to your husband about it.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: いろいろと気苦労するとは思いますが、無理なさらずにしてくださいね。本日はお話されてみていかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: I imagine you have a lot of worries, but please don't push yourself too hard. How do you feel after talking with me today?

dialogue.content: なんだか、気持ちが落ち着きました。
dialogue.English: Somehow, I feel calmer.

dialogue.content: 少しでもゆうこさんのお気持ちが軽くなるお手伝いができうれしくおもいます。それでは、ご相談終了とさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: I'm glad I could help lighten your burden, even a little. With that, we will conclude today's session.

dialogue.content: はい、有り難うございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 本日はお話を聴かせていただきありがとうございました。ゆうこさんの、ご家族のご関係がこれまで以上によきものになることをお祈りしています。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your story with me today. I hope that your family relationships become even better from now on.

dialogue.content: 有り難うございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。これでロールプレイ終了させていただきますね）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today. This concludes the role-play.)

dialogue.content: （有り難うございました。お疲れ様でした。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. That was a good session.)

dialogue.content: （それでは、失礼します。）
dialogue.English: (Well then, goodbye.)

dialogue.content: 失礼します。
dialogue.English: Goodbye.
